pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/App.tsx:21 The main-window frame routes between in-document views and holds no OS capability. Searching apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main for globalShortcut, setIgnoreCursorEvents, SendInput, @tauri-apps and WebSocket found no hits. Its references to Windows Hello are UI copy for a capability the native shell owns, so this context sits on the in-document-shell side of the golden path's discriminator.

pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/lib/data/bus.ts:115 The data layer only subscribes to events the native process pushes and turns them into cache invalidations; it holds no connection, stream or OS capability of its own. Searching apps/desktop/client/src/lib/data for WebSocket, EventSource, globalShortcut, setIgnoreCursorEvents and SendInput found no hits, so it is the pure-renderer end of a native-owned stream rather than a native integration.
